title: system.yaml, schema version 1
description: A system description of PolarFire SoC: the board, the partitions and what connects them. Read by config/gen/mpfs_gen/yaml_reader.py, which applies the defaults and the rules that a schema cannot express (config/README.md, "System description"). Every object refuses a field it does not name.

board.description: The board: the directory config/boards/<board>/, which holds its XML and its profile.

xml.description: The MSS Configurator XML, a path relative to the directory of system.yaml, and its expected SHA-256. Default: the XML of the board.

l2.description: The L2 cache. Default: as the XML configures it.

ways.description: The 16 ways shared out between cache, LIM and scratchpad; an override of the XML, so it needs a reason.

reason.description: Why the L2 differs from the XML.

cache_partitioning.description: The cache ways (0 to 15) that each hart may allocate into: a policy that the way masks of the XML must implement, checked against them, not applied. Default: none.

partitions.description: The partitions, at most one per hart.

ipc.description: The channels between two partitions. Default: none.

doorbell.description: An interrupt from one side to the other.

boot.description: The boot loader. Default: none described.

sources.description: Where the boot loader looks for the images, in this order.

fram.description: The FRAM that holds the images (boot source fram).

part.description: The part number, or auto to read its device ID.

cs.description: The chip select line, e.g. gpio0_12.

wp.description: The write protect line, or none.

name.description: A name: lower case letters, digits and single underscores, starting with a letter.

size.description: A size in bytes: an integer, 0x and hex digits, or decimal digits with K (KiB) or M (MiB).
Default: the whole region, allowed only in a system of one partition.
Default: the whole region, allowed only in a system of one partition.

harts.description: The harts: 0 is the E51, 1 to 4 the U54 cores.

priv.description: The privilege mode of the application: u (user) or m (machine).

monitor.description: The partition is the monitor, which supervises the system: the PMP checks do not restrict M mode of its harts, U mode is checked as for any partition. At most one per system.

fast_text.description: Code in the ITIM of each hart of the partition.

stacks.description: Sizes in bytes, non-zero multiples of 16.

main.description: The stack of the environment task.

interrupt.description: The interrupt stack of each hart. Default: by profile, 8192 (light, light-tasking) or 12912 (embedded).

secondary.description: The secondary stack of the environment task. Default: by profile, 16384, 8192 or 16384.

console.description: Default: the MMUART of the lowest hart (hart n: mmuartn).

peripherals.description: The peripherals that the partition owns: instance names of the SVD in lower case. The owner of fic0 to fic2, athena, mac0, mac1, usb or mmc owns the DMA master of that block and its MPU. Default: none.

interrupts.description: The interrupts that the partition handles: PLIC source names, or local:<name> for a hart-local one. Default: none.

watchdog.description: The watchdog that the partition services. Default: none.
